requirement: Edit captions owned by DOCX and RHWP group objects while preserving caption association, placement, text, and serialization.

supportedRhwpScope.hwpx: Group-owned caption text is addressable only through the exact group caption cell and verified rich paragraph/atno owner. HWPX group caption side, spacing, and lateral vertical alignment are exposed only for an unlocked, uniquely owned group caption; edits preserve all other group properties and child controls.
supportedRhwpScope.hwp5: Group-owned caption text is editable only through the verified group caption cell after the HWP original passes the safe preflight. T009 accepts only the proven caption paragraphs when the owner/control header, caption LIST_HEADER, group ShapeComponent, complete child tree, IDs, and other body objects remain unchanged. The saved PrvImage must be regenerated and independently validated. This does not enable HWP5 group caption placement editing.

implementation.rejected: Reject nested or multiple TextBox children, linked/shared/aliased stories, ambiguous/stale ownership, unsupported envelopes, and locked/tracked/non-roundtripping input. Never infer owner from adjacent Caption/SEQ paragraphs, alt text, or visual proximity.
implementation.supportedDocxScope: Only a top-level body group with exactly one direct wps:wsp TextBox child, a globally unique unlinked/unaliased TextBox story, a supported immediately adjacent group anchor, and an unlocked, untracked, losslessly round-tripping package envelope. The explicit action enters that exact child story. Structural parentage and unique story ownership are required; paragraph proximity, Caption/SEQ, alt text, and visible placement are never ownership evidence.
implementation.unsupportedDocx: Nested or multiple TextBox children, linked/shared/aliased stories, ambiguous or stale identifiers, unsupported group envelopes, locked/tracked/non-roundtripping input, and semantic Microsoft Word caption tagging are unsupported and fail closed. Nearby unowned body paragraphs remain independent.
implementation.lifecycle: The owner link is derived from the saved standard group-child/textbox-story structure, so no proprietary marker is added. Supported text and placement edits and group movement retain the same child-story owner through undo/redo and geul save/reopen. Copy remaps group/textbox story identity; deletion removes only the selected group and does not delete nearby unowned body text.

formatContractEvidence.schemaFinding: MS-ODRAWXML CT_WordprocessingGroup defines wps:wsp as a graphical child of the group, establishing standard structural parentage. The Office example documents wps:txbx/w:txbxContent as a text-box story and demonstrates linkedTxbx separately. These sources do not define a semantic group-caption role or a dedicated caption-owner field.
formatContractEvidence.decision: Use only the explicit standard group-child relation plus a unique, unlinked, non-aliased textbox story as a durable geul editing association. This is a narrow structural ownership contract, not a claim that Microsoft Word labels the text as a semantic caption. Do not infer ownership from neighboring paragraphs, Caption/SEQ, alt text, or proximity; reject unsupported or ambiguous cases.
